title: 第1261章 杨小禾一指全杀第1260章 赔了夫人又折兵的归海元
slug: 炼气期如履薄冰元婴期重拳出击
content_zh:
“动手！”
轰！
轰轰轰！
五大真仙后期以上修士齐齐出手，各自抬手一击，同时落下，围剿四头紫火金晶兽。
五道攻击汇聚，如同五条火龙同时扑杀猎物。
轰隆隆，爆炸不断，天地震颤，地龙翻身，地底岩浆冲天四溢。
四头紫火金晶兽已被归海元本命法宝自爆重创，鳞甲崩裂，紫火护罩碎裂，内核心脏暴露。
此刻被五大强者围攻，直接被一击轰杀。
真仙后期紫火金晶兽首先崩碎，十万丈巨兽如水晶雕塑般炸裂，碎片漫天飞溅。
三头真仙中期紧随其后，在五道法则轰击下化为虚无。
四大巨兽，瞬间毙命。
嗡！
真仙级紫火晶，一共四块，从漫天紫色能量气体中凝聚而出。
其中一块更是达到真仙后期中的极品，深紫近黑，内部紫色火焰如液态金浆流转，散发的火属能量之浓郁，十分接近真仙巅峰。
其余三块，都是真仙中期。
不错、不错。
五大修士抚须，半人半兽形态，齐齐面露喜色。
火兽族三人恢复半兽形态，火焰鳞甲覆盖半边身躯，眸中凶光闪烁。
地蜥族二人蛇信吞吐，赤火鳞甲在紫火映照下折射幽光。
五大真仙，皆是尾火焚天域的本土强者，每一个都身经百战。

“这是三阶仙药。”
真仙巅峰修士抬手，三阶仙药·焰蕊麒麟花飞出，悬浮于五人中间。
赤红花瓣如麒麟鳞甲，紫色花蕊燃烧天地灵焰，三阶仙药的气息弥漫方圆万里，令周围火属能量都为之一颤。
其余修士也都抛出紫火晶，一共五块。
逃走了两个人类修士，带走一块真仙中期、两块真仙初期级别的紫火晶。
火兽族一名真仙后期修士开口，语气中带着一丝杀意。
文星月、左丘岳带走的三块紫火晶，虽品质不算最高，却也是真仙级资源，价值可观。
无妨，进了焚天古墟界，迟早还能遇上。
届时，连同他们身上的资源，一网打尽。
随后，五大修士看向战利品：这些资源，要此刻分，还是日后分？
此刻分，各取所需，但可能因分配不均而翻脸。
日后分，暂时保管，但谁保管、谁先拿，又是问题。
就在五个修士思虑不定之时，有人开口了。
你们手上的资源不错，归我了。
声音突兀，来得奇怪。
content_en:
"Do it!"
Boom!
Boom boom boom!
The five cultivators in the late stage of True Immortal and above all took action together, each raised their hand to strike, and then landed at the same time, encircling and destroying the four purple fire gold crystal beasts.
The five attacks converged, like five fire dragons killing their prey at the same time.
Rumbling, explosions continued, the earth trembled, the earth dragon turned over, and magma from the ground surged into the sky.
The four purple fire gold crystal beasts have been severely injured by the self-destruction of Gui Haiyuan's natal magic weapon. The scales have cracked, the purple fire shield has shattered, and the core heart has been exposed.
At this moment, he was surrounded by five powerful men and was directly killed with one blow.
The purple fire gold crystal beast in the late stage of True Immortal was the first to shatter. The 100,000-foot giant beast exploded like a crystal sculpture, with fragments flying all over the sky.
The Three-Headed True Immortal Middle Stage followed closely behind and turned into nothingness under the bombardment of the Five Laws.
The four giant beasts were killed instantly.
Buzz!
There are four pieces of True Immortal Grade Purple Fire Crystal, condensed from the purple energy gas all over the sky.
One of them has reached the highest level in the late stage of True Immortal. It is deep purple and almost black. The purple flame inside flows like liquid gold slurry. The fire energy it emits is so rich that it is very close to the peak of True Immortal.
The remaining three pieces are all in the middle stage of true immortality.
Not bad, not bad.
The five monks were stroking their beards, in half-human and half-animal form, and all looked happy.
The three people from the fire beast tribe returned to their half-beast forms, with flame scales covering half of their bodies, and a fierce light flashing in their eyes.
The two members of the Earth Lizard Tribe hesitated, their red fire scales reflecting the faint light under the purple fire.
The five true immortals are all local strong men from the Tailhuo Burning Heaven Realm, and each of them has experienced hundreds of battles.
"This is a third-level elixir."
The cultivator at the peak of True Immortality raised his hand, and the third-level elixir Flame Core Unicorn Flower flew out and floated among the five people.
The red petals are like unicorn scales, the purple stamens are burning with the spiritual flames of heaven and earth, and the breath of the third-level elixir fills the surrounding area, making the surrounding fire energy tremble.
The other monks also threw out purple fire crystals, five in total.
Two human monks escaped and took away a middle-stage True Immortal and two early-stage True Immortal level Purple Fire Crystals.
A late-stage True Immortal cultivator from the Fire Beast Clan spoke with a hint of murderous intent in his tone.
The three purple fire crystals that Wen Xingyue and Zuo Qiuyue took away were not of the highest quality, but they were also true immortal-level resources and were of considerable value.
It doesn't matter, if you enter the Fentian Ancient Ruins world, you will encounter him sooner or later.
By then, all the resources they have will be wiped out.
Then, the five monks looked at the spoils: Should these resources be divided now or later?
At this time, everyone gets what they need, but they may fall out due to uneven distribution.
It will be divided later and kept temporarily, but who keeps it and who takes it first is another question.
Just when the five monks were thinking undecided, someone spoke.
The resources you have are good, and they belong to me.
The sound was sudden and strange.
